verified_findings.causal_reason: The changed interface I04 (Settlement status feed) has visible dependencies on several controls in the Operational report completeness review family (C093‑C100) and feeds the Reconciliation Platform (S07). C095 belongs to the same family but there is no explicit edge showing I04 directly used by or governing the same function as C095. Missing edges are known to be incomplete, so the lack of a direct link is not counter‑evidence, but without a demonstrable functional chain we cannot confirm impact.
verified_findings.counter_evidence: No explicit edge linking I04 to C095; absence of documented exclusion does not prove impact.
